snippet.title: First Look: Yi Sun-sin | Civilization VII
snippet.description:
The Admiral. Get a First Look at Yi Sun-sin in Civilization VII!

Yi Sun-sin is available the week of July 27, 2026 as part of the Brush and Blade Collection featuring two leaders, four civilizations, and four Wonders.

► Learn more about Yi Sun-sin: https://2kgam.es/4gFSsR0
► Play Civ 7 today: https://2kgam.es/Civ7
► Unlock Napoleon in Civ 7: https://2kgam.es/Napoleon

---------------------------------
HISTORY
---------------------------------
The famed admiral, Yi Sun-sin, was a man of duty and resolve. Despite a volatile career plagued by betrayal, Admiral Yi never strayed from his duty, answering the call of his king even from the depths of prison. From the splintered remains of the Korean navy, he forged a fleet of strength and led his men to victory against the overwhelming odds of the enemy, cementing his legacy as a hero to his men and to his people.

---------------------------------
ABILITY
---------------------------------
Samdo Sugun Tongjesa: Can train Fleet Commanders after studying the Discipline Civic during the Antiquity Age. Receive a free Fleet Commander once you have both a Harbor and Discipline. Defeating an enemy with a Naval Unit provides Science equal to a percentage of its Combat Strength. All Fleet Commanders receive XP upon construction of Science Buildings. Gain a set amount of Gold per Age per point of Fleet Commander XP earned in Combat.

---------------------------------
ATTRIBUTES
---------------------------------
- Militaristic
- Scientific

---------------------------------
AGENDA
---------------------------------
13 Ships: Increase Relationship with civilizations that have a minimum amount of Naval Units and Fortification Buildings. Decrease Relationship with civilizations that don't meet these minimums. 

---------------------------------
STARTING BIASES
---------------------------------
- Coastal

*This content is also included with the Brush and Blade Collection DLC Bundle. If you own the Brush and Blade Collection, then you already own this content. Terms apply.

**Base game required. Each DLC will be delivered automatically in-game on release. Terms apply.
